from scipy.optimize import curve_fit
E=np.asarray(df['eps']);TT=np.asarray(df['T']);S=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
Tr=np.round(TT,1)
for t in np.unique(Tr):
    m=Tr==t
    if m.sum()<6: continue
    e=E[m]; y=S[m]; best=None
    for k0 in [0.2,0.5,1,2,4]:
        try:
            p,_=curve_fit(lambda x,a,b,k: a+b*np.exp(-k*x), e,y, p0=[y[-1],y[0]-y[-1],k0],maxfev=20000)
            r=np.mean((p[0]+p[1]*np.exp(-p[2]*e)-y)**2)
            if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,p)
        except Exception: pass
    print(t, m.sum(), np.round(best[1],4) if best else None, best[0] if best else None)

E=np.asarray(df['eps']);TT=np.asarray(df['T']);S=np.asarray(df['sigma'])
Tr=np.round(TT,1)
trans={'lin':lambda x:x,'log':np.log,'inv':lambda x:1/x,'sqrt':np.sqrt,'sq':lambda x:x**2,'exp-':lambda x:np.exp(-x)}
for name,f in trans.items():
    out=[]
    for t in np.unique(Tr):
        m=Tr==t
        if m.sum()<6: continue
        X=np.c_[np.ones(m.sum()),f(E[m])]
        c,r,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(X,S[m],rcond=None)
        out.append(np.mean((X@c-S[m])**2)/np.var(S[m]))
    print(name, np.round(np.median(out),5), np.round(np.max(out),4))
